description: The line plot illustrates the BPC (Bits Per Character) values for two models—XMoeE Validating (yellow line) and another model (purple line)—as a function of training steps, with the x-axis representing training steps in thousands (ranging from 0 to 50×10³) and the y-axis showing BPC values from 1.25 to 2.25. Both lines exhibit a sharp initial decline in BPC from approximately 2.25 at 0 training steps to around 1.25 by 20×10³ steps, after which they plateau and remain relatively stable. The yellow line (XMoeE Validating) consistently maintains a slightly higher BPC than the purple line across all training steps, with both lines converging to nearly identical values near 1.25 by the end of the training period. The plot includes a legend identifying the yellow line as "XMoeE Validating" and the purple line as the other model, with a gray shaded region in the legend area that does not correspond to any plotted data.
